title: decision: v1 stores received consent entries, enforces nothing
description: protocol-06 §5.7. Mark 2026-11-02: received requestConsent/cancel and updateConsent grant/revoke are validated and persisted (ConsentEntry bytes as received, plus scope, operation, From domain, time) for a later JMAP surface (mimid-1wgh.12) to show users; consent::allows stays always-true (decisions .7.9 implicit allow, .21 no enforcement). request upserts a pending request for its ConsentScope; cancel deletes it (no-op if none, §5.7); grant/revoke upsert the latest decision for its scope. Rejected: accept-and-drop (Mark chose storage).
